{'text': 'Opera 今日重新推出 Opera Air 瀏覽器，採用概念與實用兼備的全新設計，提供更專注的瀏覽體驗。以下是具體內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'Opera is relaunching its Opera Air browser today with a redesign that is both conceptual and practical for a more focused browsing experience. Here’s what that means.'}

{'text': 'Opera Air 重新登場，聚焦無干擾瀏覽體驗', 'paragraph_context': 'Opera Air relaunches with renewed focus on distraction-free browsing'}

{'text': '2025 年初，Opera 公布推出 Opera Air，並將其形容為「首款以正念概念為核心打造的網頁瀏覽器」。', 'paragraph_context': 'In early 2025, Opera announced Opera Air, which the company described as “the first web browser built around the concept of mindfulness.”'}

{'text': '此後，該公司持續優化旗下整個瀏覽器系列，包括 Opera Air、Opera One 及 Neon。', 'paragraph_context': 'Since then, the company has been refining not just Opera Air but the entire family of browsers it offers, including Opera One and Neon.'}

{'text': 'Opera 今日重新推出 Opera Air，帶來基於極簡設計及整體體驗的更新，「將干擾減至最低，讓用戶有更多空間專注於重要的事」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today, Opera is relaunching Opera Air with an update that builds on its minimalist design and overall experience, and “keeps distractions to a minimum to give people more room to focus on what matters.”'}

{'text': '以下是 Opera 提供的截圖：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s Opera:'}

{'text': 'Air 設計簡約，介面乾淨，並在有需要時提供額外工具。用戶亦可將即時通訊及社交媒體應用程式加入側邊欄。', 'paragraph_context': 'Air starts simple, with a clean interface and additional tools available when wanted. Messaging and social media apps can also be added to the sidebar.'}

{'text': '是次重新設計亦為 Air 帶來全新視覺風格。煥然一新的背景圖採用開闊空間、透視感及自然質感的元素，並會自動配合淺色及深色主題。', 'paragraph_context': 'The redesign also gives Air a new visual look. Refreshed wallpapers use open spaces, perspective, and natural textures, automatically adapting to Light and Dark themes.'}

{'text': '表面簡潔，並不代表功能縮水。Air 內建廣告攔截器，令瀏覽速度更快、頁面更簡潔；同時配備免費 VPN，為用戶提供更佳的私隱及網上保障。', 'paragraph_context': 'Less on the surface doesn’t mean less underneath. Air comes with a built-in ad blocker for faster, less cluttered browsing and a free VPN for added privacy and protection online.'}

{'text': '為貫徹 Opera Air 的原有理念，今次更新仍然包含「聲景」功能，分為四大類別，結合音樂與環境聲效，助用戶專注或放鬆。', 'paragraph_context': 'In keeping with the original idea for Opera Air, today’s update still includes Soundscapes, organized into four categories, that combine music and ambient sounds to help users focus or relax.'}

{'text': '「環境音效」收錄海浪及春季森林等聲音；另有五款全新「聲景」收錄專為 Opera Air 創作的原創音樂，當中包括 Hyperfocus——一首節奏更具動感的曲目，助用戶投入工作並保持專注。', 'paragraph_context': 'Ambience brings sounds such as Sea Waves and Spring Forest, while five new Soundscapes feature original music composed specifically for Opera Air. Among them is Hyperfocus, a more energetic track designed for settling into a task and staying there.'}

{'text': '談及專注，Opera Air 亦提供一系列功能，協助用戶稍作休息及調整狀態，再繼續瀏覽。', 'paragraph_context': 'And speaking of focus, Opera Air also offers a set of features that help users take a break and regroup before resuming their browsing session.'}

{'text': '當中包括可自訂的休息提示，會彈出分為四類（紓壓、煥新、方框呼吸法、放鬆）的呼吸練習，以及頸部伸展動作。這些功能亦可從側邊欄連同「聲景」一同使用。', 'paragraph_context': 'That includes customizable break reminders that bring up breathing exercises, also divided into four categories (Destress, Refresh, Box Breathing, and Relax), as well as neck stretches.They can also be accessed from the sidebar, alongside Soundscapes.'}

{'text': 'Opera Air 免費提供，支援 macOS 及 Windows 系統，詳情可按此了解更多。', 'paragraph_context': 'Opera Air is free and available for macOS and Windows, and you can learn more about it here.'}
